headword: クラウドファンディング
reading: くらうどふぁんでぃんぐ

definitions.explanation: A method of raising funds by collecting small amounts of money from a large number of people, typically via the internet.

examples.japanese: クラウドファンディングで{資金|しきん}を{集|あつ}めた。
クラウドファンディングで{目標|もくひょう}{金額|きんがく}を{達成|たっせい}した。
examples.english: We reached our funding goal through crowdfunding.

examples.japanese: {映画|えいが}{制作|せいさく}のためにクラウドファンディングを{立|た}ち{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: They launched a crowdfunding campaign for movie production.

examples.japanese: クラウドファンディングで{新商品|しんしょうひん}を{開発|かいはつ}する。
examples.english: They're developing a new product using crowdfunding.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY: From English "crowdfunding." Often abbreviated as クラファン in casual speech.

TYPES OF CROWDFUNDING:
・{購入|こうにゅう}{型|がた} - reward-based (receive products/services)
・{寄付|きふ}{型|がた} - donation-based
・{融資|ゆうし}{型|がた} - lending-based
・{投資|とうし}{型|がた} - equity-based

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・クラウドファンディングを{立|た}ち{上|あ}げる (to launch a crowdfunding campaign)
・クラウドファンディングで{支援|しえん}する (to support via crowdfunding)
・クラウドファンディングの{目標|もくひょう}{金額|きんがく} (crowdfunding goal amount)
・クラウドファンディングのリターン (crowdfunding rewards)

POPULAR PLATFORMS IN JAPAN:
・CAMPFIRE
・Makuake
・READYFOR

CULTURAL NOTE: Crowdfunding has become popular in Japan for creative projects, disaster relief, and small business ventures. The concept of gathering small contributions from many supporters resonates with traditional Japanese group-oriented values.
